evidenceRule: A cell is supported only by its receiving acceptance passing on the pinned release. An architecture proof (ANGP), an installed compiler and syntax highlighting (ANG1G) are never product evidence.

parserDecisions.sublanguage: binding and interpolation expressions, event statements, pipes and *dir microsyntax
parserDecisions.grammar: dedicated Angular expression grammar in H02, not an OXC specialisation
parserDecisions.reason: The Angular expression language is not an ECMAScript subset OXC can parse: `|` is the pipe operator with `:` arguments and every bitwise operator is unsupported; declarations, arrow functions, `new` and the comma operator are rejected; event bindings are `;`-separated statements; *dir microsyntax (`let x of xs; index as i`) and the `$any`/`$safeNavigationMigration` forms are Angular-only (adev/src/content/guide/templates/expression-syntax.md at v22.2.1). Type answers come from tsgo over the ANG6 companion, so no TS semantics live in this grammar.
